profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with 15 years of experience developing and testing C#/C++ applications for Windows. 
Well-versed in leveraging telemetry to understand customer usage and discover bugs.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Data engineer for Windows Bluetooth and Camera team. 
•	Designed and implemented business-critical data processing and analysis 
allowing Windows Camera to respond to major usage changes due to COVID-19. 
Reports showed the renewed importance of camera on Windows and detected 
customer problems.
• Maintained and upgraded Bluetooth C# MVVM UWP application enabling 
internal and partner testing of Bluetooth LE devices with Windows.
• Created common telemetry event framework utilized by several teams. 
Framework processes 1 PB/month saving engineering effort and cloud resources
through optimized shared infrastructure. 
• Designed and built new data pipeline for the Bluetooth team in Azure Data 
Warehouse. Performed detailed analysis solving performance issues and created 
reports answering business questions for multiple teams.
• Enabled automated deployment, code standards, and pre-prod/prod 
environments to ensure infrastructure efficiency and reliability.
• Implemented compliance with Europe’s General Data Protection Regulations.
• Developed telemetry-based tests to detect regressions during testing ensuring
product is working as expected

positions.title: World Traveller
positions.description: Travelling the world - Vietnam, Cambodia, Laos, South Korea, Taiwan, Japan, Sweden, Germany, Denmark, Norway, US, Thailand, Finland, Russia, Estonia, Poland

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description:
•	Collaborated with AllJoyn open source project to integrate internet of things capabilities into Windows 10.
•	Implemented new security features including those from Windows into the AllJoyn stack in conjunction with the AllJoyn team. 
•	Developed automated infrastructure to pull the latest open source code into Windows 10 builds.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer in Test II
positions.description:
•	Created test framework and coordinated Windows Phone-wide team which validated device functionality after update. 
•	Managed a test pass running on 300+ daily branches, catching complex data migration issues and preventing update-breaking bugs from reaching self-host builds.
•	 Owned device update outreach to testers and management.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer in Test II
positions.description:
•	Led testing of the cloud backup and restore feature for Windows Phone 8.
•	Collaborated with partner teams across Windows Phone to ensure backup and restore functionality for their features across different versions of Windows Phone
•	Developed the C++ automation framework used by the team to test functional and end-to-end features.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer in Test
positions.description:
•	Authored C#/C++ functional and end-to-end tests for the desktop update software for Windows Phone 7 devices. 
•	Created a device update reliability lab which tested thousands of iterations of software updates on retail phones, ensuring blocking update bugs were discovered and fixed before deployment.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer in Test Summer Intern
positions.description: •	Tested enterprise software deployment for the Mobile Device Manager team.

positions.title: Summer Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
Research and Development for the RAIN Project

Built Analog filter circuits and set up digital signal software for TI DSPs with Python data collection for monitoring.

company.name: Rice University Electrical and Computer Engineering

projects.description: Set up automated control for rgb and non-rgb holiday lights by wiring DMX and arduino controllers. Programmed light show using xLights software.
